sql: SELECT p.id FROM people p WHERE p.workspace_id = $1 AND p.merged_into IS NULL AND ((p.traits @> $2::jsonb AND p.traits @> $3::jsonb AND COALESCE(((jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $4::text)) IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $4::text)) <> 'null')), false) AND COALESCE((NOT (jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $4::text)) IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof((p.traits -> $4::text)) <> 'null')), false)))
